sentences.text:
Kuldeep Singh Tomar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10
February, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:2758
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Gwalior

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajendra Kumar Vani

On The 10th Of February, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 441 of 2025
 Kuldeep Singh Tomar
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Ravi Dwivedi - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Mohit Shivhare -Public Prosecutor for the respon
 Order

1. This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS (439 of Cr.P.C.)
for grant of bail relating to Crime No.525/2024 registered at Police Station Hazira, District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offence under Section 75(2) of BNS and Section 7/8 of POCSO Act.
2. The allegation levelled against the applicant is that he caught hold the prosecutrix with bad intention to touch her breast.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the first bail application of the applicant was withdrawn vide order dated 18.12.2024 with liberty to revive his prayer after filing of charge-sheet.
Charge-sheet was filed on the same day in the trial Court.
Copy of the order-sheet is filed at page No.5 of I.A.No.1836/25.
Therefore, he preferred this second bail application before this Court.

It is also submitted that in another case under Section 376 of IPC the F.I.R. has been quashed and order-sheet of that case NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:2758 2 MCRC-441-2025 is filed at page No.9.
Another case under Section 194 of IPC etc. has been registered on the basis of earlier case under Section 376 of IPC in which F.I.R. has been quashed.
Applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
He is ready and willing to abide by all the terms and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On these grounds, learned counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
4. Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application and prayed for its dismissal.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
